skill.name: personwise-sales-onboarding
skill.description: Build grounded sales onboarding courses from approved playbooks and ramp plans using the PersonWise CLI and digital-human course service.
skill.summary: Turn approved sales materials into an interactive new-rep ramp course with source-grounded scripts, reviews, and controlled publishing.
skill.author: personwiseai

security_audit.summary: All 142 static findings are false positives caused by defensive installer operations, Markdown code formatting, or signed descriptor data. Three semantic risks remain around external uploads, credit consumption, and the opaque PersonWise CLI trust boundary.

remediation.issue: Selected source documents are transferred to the PersonWise service.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the destination and request confirmation immediately before the first upload, especially for confidential sales materials.

remediation.issue: Course creation consumes existing credits without renewed confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Show the expected credit charge and request confirmation before consumption unless the user explicitly approved that cost.

remediation.issue: The installed CLI is opaque and installer trust details are intentionally suppressed.
remediation.suggestion: Provide reproducible source provenance and a concise installation disclosure covering the binary, destination, publisher, service access, and verification method.

content.value_statement: New sales representatives need consistent training grounded in approved materials. This skill creates and reviews an interactive PersonWise course with controlled access.
actual_capabilities: Designs a new-rep course arc from approved playbooks and onboarding plans.
Authenticates through browser OAuth and checks live course creation readiness.
Creates PersonWise course blueprints with explicit page counts and private default access.
Uploads user-selected source documents and tracks their processing status.
Reviews outline, script, and image checkpoints before advancing the course run.
Publishes private or link-access courses and submits Topics when requested.
limitations: Requires the PersonWise CLI, browser OAuth, an active account, and service availability.
Course creation may consume existing PersonWise credits.
Selected files are uploaded to PersonWise and must comply with organizational privacy rules.
Output quality depends on supplied materials and does not prove learner competence or certification.

use_cases.title: Launch a new-rep ramp
use_cases.description: Convert an approved sales playbook and ramp plan into a private, interactive onboarding course.

use_cases.title: Standardize frontline coaching
use_cases.description: Create a consistent course covering discovery, pipeline stages, proof points, and escalation owners.

use_cases.title: Maintain controlled training
use_cases.description: Review source processing, course checkpoints, access settings, and final delivery evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic onboarding course
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a private sales onboarding course from the attached playbook. Focus on mission, buyer, approved story, process, and first-week actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one approved source

prompt_templates.title: Build a materials-only ramp
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an eight-page materials-only course from these documents. Include ramp milestones, discovery practice, pipeline rules, and named escalation owners.
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured course with strict source grounding

prompt_templates.title: Refine an existing course
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the existing course snapshot. Preserve slide order, correct unsupported claims, remove repetition, and improve alignment between titles, points, text, and scripts.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a multi-course rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three role-specific onboarding courses. Recheck readiness before each course, verify every source, review all checkpoints, and enable link access only where requested.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced program with live limits and access controls

output_examples.input: Create a private onboarding course from our playbook and 30-day ramp plan.
output_examples.output: Created a private eight-page course covering mission, ramp milestones, discovery, proof points, pipeline process, practice, and escalation owners. All sources completed processing.

output_examples.input: Update the course because two slides contain unsupported customer claims.
output_examples.output: Removed both unsupported claims, aligned the affected scripts with approved evidence, preserved slide order, and completed the next review checkpoint.

output_examples.input: Share the finished course with the regional sales team.
output_examples.output: Enabled link access after checking the current course state. Returned the playable share link and reported the final access mode.

best_practices: Supply approved playbooks, ramp plans, pricing guidance, and named escalation owners.
State the desired page count and access mode before course creation.
Review privacy requirements before uploading confidential sales documents.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent customer results, competitive claims, or quota expectations.
Do not upload files that lack authorization for third-party processing.
Do not treat a created run, submitted Topic, or private editor link as public completion evidence.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Use approved sales playbooks, onboarding plans, product guidance, process documentation, and clearly selected reference images.

faq.question: Does this skill require a PersonWise account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires browser OAuth, the PersonWise CLI, an active account, and available service capacity.

faq.question: Can it create a course only from supplied documents?
faq.answer: Yes. Request materials-only mode, and the workflow will retain source grounding throughout course generation and review.

faq.question: Will it use course credits?
faq.answer: New course creation may consume existing PersonWise credits. The workflow never purchases credits automatically.

faq.question: Are uploaded files processed externally?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected source documents are uploaded to PersonWise for processing and must meet your privacy requirements.

faq.question: Can it publish a course publicly?
faq.answer: It can enable link access when requested. Otherwise, new courses default to private access.
